title: Near-Floor Geometry Is Generic: Leverage Dispersion in Trained Overcomplete Codes
abstract: arXiv:2605.01192v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: An overcomplete code packs $F$ features into $d<F$ dimensions, so linear readout of one feature picks up cross-talk from the others, bounded below by the rank-trace floor $W(F,d)=(F-d)/(d(F-1))$. Proximity to this floor is read as evidence of an efficient arrangement. It is not: an i.i.d. code of the same shape attains it at every shape and load we measure (1.0000-1.0005 over 7 matched controls), and the reason is exact. For the gain-calibrated pseudoinverse the attainment ratio is $\frac{d}{F(F-d)}(\sum_i h_i^{-1}-F)$ with $\sum_i h_i=d$, so it equals one precisely when the leverage $h_i$ is equalised across features: distance from the floor IS leverage dispersion. translated_title: 近地板几何是普遍的：训练过的过完备码中的杠杆离散度
translated_abstract: 过完备码将F个特征打包进d<F维的空间中，因此对一个特征的线性读取会拾取来自其他特征的串扰，其下界由秩-迹地板 W(F,d)=(F-d)/(d(F-1)) 限定。与该地板的接近程度通常被解读为高效排列的证据，但事实并非如此：同形状的独立同分布（i.i.d.）码在我们测量的每种形状和负载下都能达到该下界（在7个匹配对照组中达到1.0000-1.0005），且其原因是精确的：对于增益校准的伪逆，实现比率为 d/(F(F-d))(Σᵢ hᵢ⁻¹ - F)，其中 Σᵢ hᵢ=d，因此当且仅当杠杆 hᵢ 在各特征间均衡时该比率才等于一——距地板的距离就是杠杆离散度。在40个已发布的解码器矩阵上——包括24个稀疏自编码器解码器以及16个混合模型的MLP下投影——全部位于其匹配对照组之上（1.0055-1.2018），且全部提前4到40个稀疏度水平达到保证的仿射失效：当同形状的随机码……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文从理论上精确证明与秩-迹地板的距离本质上是特征杠杆的离散度（杠杆均衡的i.i.d.码普遍即可达到地板），并在40个实际发布的训练解码器矩阵上发现它们均偏离地板且更早出现保证的仿射失效。
en_tdlr: Distance from the rank-trace floor is exactly leverage dispersion—i.i.d. codes with equalized leverage attain the floor generically—yet all 40 released trained decoder matrices sit above matched random controls and reach guaranteed affine failure earlier.
